narrative: 如果这场戏是一场暴动、一次楼梯间的追逐，或一座不肯安分守己的城市，那么静止感就会是一种谎言。对角线推动着视线，拒绝家具般平静的地平线。
它不适合用于一次正式的条约签署、一个关于秩序的笑话，或一张必须成为祭坛的脸。如果你为了假装出一条布景本身并不存在的对角线而转动摄影机，那你做出的其实是荷兰角（Dutch Angle），这是完全不同的语句。
一条强烈的偏斜线就足够了：一处扶手、一道阴影、一把枪。让画面充满意外的斜线并不算构图，
那只是一个歪斜的布景而已。
how: 除非你确实想要荷兰角效果，否则要保持机身水平。在调度或建筑中找到一条偏斜的矢量线，把主体放在这条线上，或与之对抗。
较广的镜头会增强纵深对角线的冲力。硬光可以投下一条阴影，作为第二条线。
提示词：Diagonal composition through [Subject], energy on the bias, unstable, rain or stairs as the line.
when: 用它表现楼梯、街角、雨水、战斗，以及任何一种如果用水平构图就会让场景显得过于平静的段落。不要为了伪造一条场地本身并不提供的线条而转动摄影机。
vs: 荷兰角（Dutch Angle）转动摄影机，让地平线本身倾斜。对角线构图则可以在保持真实水平线的同时，让楼梯和身体穿越画面构成斜线。
引导线（Leading Lines）可以是对角线，但也可以是沿轴线延伸的笔直走廊。单点透视（One-Point Perspective）通常是一条方正、带仪式感的隧道。
非对称构图（Asymmetry）在不需要偏斜线条的情况下偏移质量。
examples_film: 《战舰波将金号》（Battleship Potemkin）把步枪、楼梯和人群都推向斜线，使这场屠杀无法安静下来；《第三人》（The Third Man）把维也纳的街道、楼梯和湿漉漉的阴影变成对角线陷阱，而摄影机常常只是恰好站在了对的位置。
这是关于不稳定感的语法，而不是一个倾斜预设。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是荷兰角。破绽是倾斜的地平线，却没有任何建筑上的对角线。
修正方法：把摄影机调平，找到真正能切割画面的楼梯、墙角，或身体姿态。

faq.q: 电影中的对角线构图（Diagonal Composition）是什么？
faq.a: 它是一种以斜线组织的画面：楼梯、街道、雨水、身体、阴影都作为对角矢量出现。能量和不稳定感来自这些线条。摄影机本身可以保持水平，是布景在发生倾斜。

faq.q: 对角线构图（Diagonal Composition）与荷兰角（Dutch Angle）有何区别？
faq.a: 荷兰角转动摄影机，让整个世界都倾斜。对角线构图使用的是场景中本就存在的线条。两者可以同时出现，但一条倾斜的地平线并不天然等同于对角线构图，而摄影机水平时拍到的楼梯也不算荷兰角。

faq.q: 什么时候该用对角线构图（Diagonal Composition）？
faq.a: 当一种方正、平稳的构图会显得虚假时使用它：追逐、楼梯、街头暴力、切割画面的天气。不要把它当成平静室内场景的默认斜线处理。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写对角线构图（Diagonal Composition）的提示词？
faq.a: 说明偏斜线以及摄影机是否水平。示例：Diagonal composition through [Subject], energy on the bias, unstable, rain or stairs as the line。指明具体的线条。加上“地平线水平”以避免出现不想要的荷兰角效果。

narrative: Stillness would be a lie if the scene is a riot, a chase down stairs, or a city that will not sit square. Diagonals shove the eye and refuse a calm horizon of furniture.

It is the wrong tool for a formal treaty, a joke about order, or a face that needs to be an altar. If you roll the camera to fake a diagonal that the set does not have, you have made a dutch angle, which is a different sentence.
A single strong bias line can be enough: a banister, a shadow, a gun. Filling the frame with accidental slants is not composition.
how: Keep the head level unless you truly want a dutch. Find a bias vector in blocking or architecture and place the subject on it or against it.
A wider lens increases the thrust of a receding diagonal. Hard light can throw a diagonal shadow as a second line.
Prompt: Diagonal composition through [Subject], energy on the bias, unstable, rain or stairs as the line.
when: Use it for stairs, street corners, rain, battles, and any beat where a level diagram would calm the scene down. Do not roll the camera to counterfeit a line the location does not offer.
vs: Dutch Angle rolls the camera so the horizon itself tilts. Diagonal composition can keep a true horizon while stairs and bodies cut across.
Leading Lines may be diagonal, but they can also be straight corridors on axis. One-Point Perspective is usually a square, ceremonial tunnel.
Asymmetry offsets mass without requiring a bias line.
examples_film: Battleship Potemkin drives rifles, stairs, and crowds on the bias so the massacre cannot sit still. The Third Man turns Vienna's streets, stairs, and wet shadows into diagonal traps while the camera is often simply in the right place.
Grammar of instability, not a tilt preset.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dutch Angle. The tell is a tilted horizon and no architectural diagonal.
The fix is to level the camera and find stairs, a corner, or a gesture that actually cuts the frame.

faq.q: What is diagonal composition in film?
faq.a: It is a picture organized on the bias: stairs, streets, rain, bodies, shadows as diagonal vectors. Energy and instability come from those lines. The camera may remain level. The set does the tilting.

A dutch angle rolls the camera so the whole world lists. Diagonal composition uses lines already in the scene. You can have both, but a rolled horizon is not automatically a diagonal composition, and stairs on a level camera are not a dutch.

faq.q: When should I use diagonal composition?
faq.a: Use it when a square, restful diagram would lie: pursuit, stairs, street violence, weather that cuts. Do not use it as a default slant on a calm interior.

faq.q: How do I prompt diagonal composition for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the bias and whether the camera is level. Example: Diagonal composition through [Subject], energy on the bias, unstable, rain or stairs as the line. Specify the line. Add horizon level to block an unwanted dutch.
